caption: The drawing features a head and upper shoulders of a human figure rendered primarily in pencil on a beige-toned paper with some areas, particularly the turban-style head covering, lightly shaded in brownish hues. The head covering is detailed with multiple curved folds and appears to be wrapped around the head, with additional shading to suggest depth and texture. The face of the figure is left mostly blank, with only faint outlines indicating placement of the eyes, nose, and mouth. The figure has a band of circular shapes, possibly representing a beaded or floral headband, across the forehead and continuing behind the ears. Around the neck, there is a ruffled or leafy collar, comprised of multiple contiguous, jagged-edged pieces. In the lower right corner of the drawing, two additional head coverings are sketched: one is a circular arrangement resembling the main turban, while the other appears to be a collar with similar ruffles. The entire composition is executed in fine, precise lines, with minimal use of color except for the light brown shading that emphasizes the folds and contours of the head covering. The paper background is an off-white to cream color, with a slight gradient of darker tan at the upper edge.
title: Headdress
